test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bats are balls.

All balls are wickets.

**Conclusions:**

I. All wickets are balls.

II. All bats are wickets.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

Conclusions:

(I) All wickets are balls → Does not follow (As all balls are wickets. So it is possible but not definite.)
